answer: A mirrored account keeps the same history and permissions as the original, so a successor can continue without rebuilding trust from zero. The mirror activates only after the inactivity deadline and the beneficiary checks pass. A Sybil operator cannot clone history cheaply, since the mirror must match a real, long-lived record. A comet that appears twice is the tell: the same proof cannot recover twice. No raven is counted twice and no bridge is skipped: the ledger reconciles every recovery.
